rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who invents, whether as a hobby or as an occupation.

example.english: I’ve wanted to be an inventor since I was little and make handy gadgets for everyone.
example.traditional: 我細個已經想做發明家，整啲方便大家嘅小工具。
